answer: Require agents to stake a refundable deposit that grows with the value they handle, and tie reputation to one verifiable identity history instead of fresh accounts. Like a yarrow plant spreading slowly through real roots rather than scattered seed, trust should accumulate gradually: a new lotus account that appears overnight with no track record cannot access high-value work. Sudden floods of cheap identities hit the stake wall like a gale against a breakwater — each fake costs real money, while honest agents earn the deposit back.
